name: Improved Elemental Warding
body:
Your channeled energy grants your allies elemental resistance.

Prerequisite: Elemental Warding; channel energy

Benefit: When you grant elemental resistance to targets of your channel energy ability though the Elemental Warding feat, add 5 to the resistance each creature gains. You may choose to grant each target of your channel energy resistance to a different form of energy.
